situation.line: Houthi forces hold the Red Sea coast, including Mocha and Hays, while contesting positions across western Taiz and northern Lahj.
situation.more: Government forces maintain defensive lines protecting the approaches to Taiz city and the energy fields of Marib.

fronts.name: Bab al-Mandab
fronts.line: The strait and the high ground above it carry the shipping lane between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden.

fronts.name: Red Sea coast
fronts.line: The Red Sea coast controls access to Hodeidah, the main import route for the north.

fronts.name: Taiz
fronts.line: Western Taiz is the hinge between the coast and the highlands, and the approach to Taiz city.

fronts.name: Marib
fronts.line: Marib holds Yemen's main oil and gas infrastructure and the government's northern stronghold.

fronts.name: Al-Dhale
fronts.line: Al-Dhale and Lahj sit astride the roads north from Aden.

fronts.name: Al-Jawf
fronts.line: Al-Jawf is the northern desert flank, linking Marib to the Saudi border.

fronts.name: Saudi Arabia
fronts.line: The Saudi home front is where long-range fire and air defence alerts register inside the kingdom.

numbers.line: No fighting was reported in the 6 hours to 12:00 on 9 Oct.
